fit_reason: Although marked private seller, the photos show the truck staged in front of a sales building with posted sales hours and a lot full of other vehicles, and the description reads like dealer copy, so this looks like dealer stock rather than a private owner sale.
findings: Black paint on the doors, bed sides and tailgate is already clean and glossy with sharp reflections
Chrome bumpers and wheels look clean and bright
Black trim and fender flares look dark, not faded
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Ram 2500. The black paint and chrome already look sharp in the photos. If you ever want a pre-sale interior and exterior detail done at your place, we come to you. Would you like a quote?
